Verified the new pure `src/decision` package (`src/decision/commands.ts`, `src/decision/derive.ts`, `src/decision/ids.ts`, `src/decision/snapshot.ts`) and its test suite (`tests/decision/derive.test.ts`, `tests/decision/snapshot-builder.ts`) added by `group_a`:

- `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes with zero errors.
- All 29 tests in `tests/decision/derive.test.ts` pass, and all 115 tests across the repository pass without regressions.
- Confirmed that the materialization, cycle detection, dependency resolution, unit satisfaction, work-order admission/capacity, revision handling, and run completion rules match the existing materialization and decision behaviour.
